About Adcore’s Blog At its core, Adcore is a digital agency providing advanced technological solutions on top of marketing managed services. Our blog’s primary focus is to educate marketers and inspire them with marketing-related topics. We encourage talented writers to contribute original ideas, share the latest trends, and create marketing guides for our readers. Our Audience Our audience ranges from beginners to advanced marketers, account managers, PPC automation specialists, and CMOs. Desired Blog Post Topics In general, we post content that covers best practices, marketing strategy, how-to’s, and professional guides. Posts we accept for guest content fall under the following themes: All leading advertising platforms – Google, Facebook, Microsoft, LinkedIn, Outbrain, Pinterest, TikTok, and Instagram. Paid search, display & social Marketing Automation tools E-commerce Google Analytics & reporting CRO (Conversion rate optimization) Marketing Strategy PPC (Pay-per-click) Ad Creative & Copy Industry trends and news While brainstorming what to write about, ask yourself these questions: Will this topic be relevant to the Adcore audience? We want to share content that is authoritative but not robotic. All content MUST BE ORIGINAL. We do not accept duplicate or syndicated content as guest posts. Always name your sources.
